mechanism: Alendronate can cause esophageal irritation and ulceration, and potassium supplements may have additive local irritant effects on the GI tract; additionally, bisphosphonates can affect mineral metabolism and electrolyte balance.
action: Avoid concurrent use of potassium supplements with alendronate; if potassium supplementation is necessary, separate administration by at least 30 minutes and ensure adequate hydration; monitor serum potassium levels regularly.
